summary: Interpreted the CheckQuorum multi-voter receipt (check 11c411f5e9734ad6bb95fffd61f1b7c8, experiment f87487ff). All five comparisons resolved and the witness was violated: after the removal node 1 still led a two-voter configuration, three heartbeat rounds passed with node 2 and node 3 still followers at term 1 and no replacement elected, the request was taken into the read-only round with two heartbeats broadcast, and after three further rounds the removed leader was still the leader at its own term with the request answered. That corrects a bound the account previously stated: the one-tick end of the exposure is a property of a replacement leader existing, not of the quorum option alone - the singleton remainder elects its replacement, PreVote lets the voters grant a new election, but with CheckQuorum and a multi-voter remainder the voters keep answering the removed leader, refuse each other's votes inside their leases and elect nobody, so the removed leader keeps serving a read from a round it counted its own acknowledgement into although it is not one of the configuration's voters. The account now covers five configurations, none of which produces the outcome the question allows, and I recorded two honest caveats in the counterevidence: that receipt's setup event still carries a prevote:true label copied from the harness it was derived from (the executed configuration was CheckQuorum with PreVote off), and its voters were never ticked, so the receipt shows the removed leader keeping its lease over six rounds it initiates rather than proving that a ticked voter could never campaign. Validation reports valid with the investigation discriminator and interpretation effects.
